text:
lucy (partnerships): Quick sync — Arbor wants a compact perf kickoff focused on perf/W knee detection for rdx-13b on their A120. Can we scope a tiny matrix and install window?

mike (perf-eng): Yes. Proposal: short sweeps at seq 256/768/1024, QPS ramp 10->200, measure perf/W and knee QPS. Keep runs short (20m) to get steady-state region.

nina (eng-runtime): Need PMBus + host RAPL + kernel op timings. I'll add a small agent that writes jsonl to s3. Sampling: 10Hz for PMBus, 2Hz for RAPL.

kevin @ArborCompute: We'll ship probe and a wiring sheet. Can also provide card power CSVs and a firmware toggle to disable turbo smoothing. ETA May 18.

tom (lab-ops): Blocking window May 19 08:00-12:00 PT for install and May 20 09:00-16:00 for runs. Image: redwood-perf-2026-05-01. I'll snapshot prior.

sched-bot: Event created "Arbor mini perf knee" May 19 08:00 PT (install), May 20 09:00 PT (runs).

lucy (partnerships): Action items:
- nina: telemetry agent + json schema (include pmbus.power,pmbus.temp,host.rapl,op.lat_ms)
- mike: minimal workload CSV and perf/W calc recipe (instant + steady avg)
- kevin: probe ETA and wiring PDF
- tom: confirm image + serial access

mike (perf-eng): I'll normalize perf/W both raw and per-TDP, and include kernel flag list. Uploading workload CSV to s3 by EOD.

nina (eng-runtime): ack — opening PR with telemetry schema and harness example. Will log runtime git sha.

kevin @ArborCompute: ack — kit ships May 17, arrives May 18. Wiring PDF attached via DM.

tom (lab-ops): image confirmed, serial console enabled. Snapshot saved at s3://redwood-perf/arbor/1771229999/snapshot.tar.gz

lucy (partnerships): Perfect. We'll use this thread for quick updates only. Post-run we'll draft a short marketplace blurb (needs legal signoff).

mike (perf-eng): One more: include a column for thermal throttles in the output csv. Helps interpret perf dips.

nina (eng-runtime): good call. adding thermal_event boolean to schema.

lucy (partnerships): Thanks all — see you at install.
